7509.title: Detached cancellation loses plugin ownership without stack frames
7509.rootCauseOneLine: Outside a background-service run, containment relies on plugin stack locations; a frameless native cancellation has none and is unclaimed by the fatal server exception path.
7509.proposedFix: Define safe execution ownership that preserves core-error non-attribution; do not globally swallow frameless errors or AbortErrors.
7509.caveats: Synthetic containment gap repeated in two clean checkouts. Original desktop crashes and their abort source were not reproduced. The test intercepts the uncaught event rather than exiting a full server; no safe decision-free fix was established. Runnable patch is embedded in the report under reports repository policy.
